Condition: NOTE 1:If different SMTC periodicities are configured for different cells, the SMTC period in the requirement is the one used by the cell being identifiedNOTE 2:When DRX is not configured, Lmeas is the number of SMTC occasions not available at the UE during T SSB_measurement_period_intra_CCA for measurement, where Lmeas <Lmeas,max.
